evidence.claim: Jokowi said corruption is the root of development problems and that the government would not tire of pushing Indonesia toward a clean and advanced state, while noting that major graft cases such as Jiwasraya, Asabri, and Garuda had been uncovered.
evidence.title: Pidato lengkap Presiden Jokowi dalam Sidang Tahunan MPR 2022
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said corruption is the root of development problems and that the government would not tire of pushing Indonesia toward a clean and advanced state, while noting that major graft cases such as Jiwasraya, Asabri, and Garuda had been uncovered.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct transcript of a presidential speech published by a major wire service with exact quotations and date.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi as his own national address.
contrary_evidence: This is rhetoric and self-presentation; it does not by itself prove truthful conduct or absence of self-dealing.

evidence.claim: After a Supreme Court justice was named as a bribery suspect, Jokowi ordered Mahfud MD to handle the matter, urged people to wait for the KPK process, and said everyone is equal before the law.
evidence.title: President Jokowi Emphasizes Law Reform Urgency in Indonesia
evidence.excerpt: After a Supreme Court justice was named as a bribery suspect, Jokowi ordered Mahfud MD to handle the matter, urged people to wait for the KPK process, and said everyone is equal before the law.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official cabinet-secretariat publication quoting the president directly and tying the statement to a specific corruption case.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 response to a live corruption scandal.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi; he issued the instruction and public stance himself.
contrary_evidence: A public commitment to legal equality is not proof that enforcement was fully even-handed in practice.

evidence.claim: Jokowi filed his 2022 wealth report to the KPK on 17 March 2023; the report listed total assets of Rp82.369.583.676 and no debt.
evidence.title: LHKPN Lengkap, Ini Rincian Harta Jokowi yang Naik Jadi Rp 82,3 M
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi filed his 2022 wealth report to the KPK on 17 March 2023; the report listed total assets of Rp82.369.583.676 and no debt.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Report is based on the KPK e-LHKPN filing and gives concrete asset and filing details for the target year.
evidence.period_fit: Directly covers the 2022 reporting period even though published in 2023.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi's own mandatory asset disclosure.
contrary_evidence: Self-reported asset filings do not rule out undisclosed conflicts or assets.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said he appointed Zulkifli Hasan and Hadi Tjahjanto based on track record, experience, and managerial skill to solve problems in detail.
evidence.title: Presiden Jokowi Ungkap Alasan Penunjukan Zulkifli Hasan dan Hadi Tjahjanto
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said he appointed Zulkifli Hasan and Hadi Tjahjanto based on track record, experience, and managerial skill to solve problems in detail.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official transcript of Jokowi's own explanation for cabinet appointments, with concrete quoted rationale.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi because the appointment rationale is his own public justification.
contrary_evidence: A competence-based rationale does not exclude coalition balancing or patronage motives.

evidence.claim: The trade minister was removed after soaring cooking-oil prices and shortages, with the crisis linked to arrests of Trade Ministry officials and palm-oil businessmen allegedly involved in graft.
evidence.title: Jokowi orders seventh Cabinet reshuffle
evidence.excerpt: The trade minister was removed after soaring cooking-oil prices and shortages, with the crisis linked to arrests of Trade Ministry officials and palm-oil businessmen allegedly involved in graft.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reputable national reporting on the reshuffle, with a clear causal narrative tied to a corruption-tinged supply crisis.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to Jokowi's decision to reshuffle and replace the minister after the scandal and shortage crisis.
contrary_evidence: The source also suggests the move was reactive damage control rather than evidence of a clean appointment process.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said WTP was not the final goal and that the government should use, manage, and utilize public money transparently and accountably, then follow BPK recommendations to fix weaknesses.
evidence.title: Presiden: Opini WTP atas LKPP bukan tujuan akhir
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said WTP was not the final goal and that the government should use, manage, and utilize public money transparently and accountably, then follow BPK recommendations to fix weaknesses.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Directly quotes Jokowi in a dated report tied to the 2021 state accounts audit and his response to it.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi as his own position on audit findings and public-finance management.
contrary_evidence: A transparency-oriented statement does not itself prove that all spending or appointments were clean.

evidence.claim: Jokowi told police to address public complaints about extortion, arbitrariness, and luxurious living, and to restore public trust through disciplined law enforcement.
evidence.title: Lima Arahan Presiden Jokowi kepada Jajaran Polri
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi told police to address public complaints about extortion, arbitrariness, and luxurious living, and to restore public trust through disciplined law enforcement.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official transcript with direct presidential instructions to a national law-enforcement institution.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi because he personally issued the orders.
contrary_evidence: This is an ethical directive to subordinates, not proof of Jokowi's own private conduct.

evidence.claim: On Anti-Corruption Day 2022, Jokowi said corruption is the source of many development problems and that the government would not tire or slacken in pushing Indonesia to be clean and advanced.
evidence.title: Jokowi: Korupsi pangkal dari berbagai masalah pembangunan
evidence.excerpt: On Anti-Corruption Day 2022, Jokowi said corruption is the source of many development problems and that the government would not tire or slacken in pushing Indonesia to be clean and advanced.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct quote from the president on a dated anti-corruption commemoration, relayed by a major wire service.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strongly attributable to Jokowi as his own anti-corruption message.
contrary_evidence: Again, this is a public statement rather than direct proof of integrity in office.
